{{Top|leg}}
'''Point Bleak''' was the muster point that [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Matric Klauskin]] used for the [[Second Fleet|fleet's]] [[Operation Roundabout|show of force]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].

When the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] and [[Commenor/Legends|Commenorian]] launched their surprise attack on the [[Blockade of Corellia]], Admiral [[Tarla Limpan|Limpan]] ordered the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|fleet]] to retreat to Point Bleak after strafing [[Centerpoint Station]].
